fields.label: Evapotranspiration Fractions
fields.help: Enter the fraction of precipitation that evapotranspires. Valid values are 0 to 1. The default value is 0.35. Note that this fraction, the groundwater seepage fraction, and the runoff fraction must total 1.0.

fields.label: Groundwater Seepage Fractions
fields.help: Enter the fraction of precipitation that seeps into groundwater for all areas in the modeling. Valid values are 0 to 1. The default value is 0.25. Note that this fraction, the evapotranspiration fraction, and the runoff fraction must total 1.0.

fields.label: Runoff Fractions
fields.help: Enter the fraction of precipitation that contributes to overland runoff for all areas in the modeling. Valid values are 0 to 1. The default value is 0.4. Note that this fraction, the evapotranspiration fraction, and the groundwater seepage fraction must total 1.0.
